property_summary: For any successful payable fallback call (msg.value == 10 ether) when block.timestamp > pastBlockTime, the reference contract always sets pastBlockTime to a value that is strictly greater than the value read immediately after the call (i.e., address(c).pastBlockTime() > block.timestamp), while the mutant can leave pastBlockTime equal to block.timestamp causing address(c).pastBlockTime() <= block.timestamp for some inputs.
change_summary: Set pastBlockTime to block.timestamp (no +1), altering the stored value and subsequent comparisons.
